title: 意识
sub: 我们对自己与外界的主观体验——能「觉察到正在发生什么」的那部分心智。
subEn: Our subjective awareness of self and world — the part of the mind that knows something is happening.

title: 记忆
sub: 把信息编码、储存、并在需要时为所用的能力。
subEn: The ability to encode, store, and retrieve information when needed.

title: 情绪
sub: 由生理唤醒、主观感受和行为倾向共同组成的复杂状态，如喜、怒、恐、悲。
subEn: A complex state of physiological arousal, subjective feeling and action tendency — joy, anger, fear, sadness.

title: 动机
sub: 推动我们发起、维持并指向某目标的内部动力。
subEn: The internal drive that initiates, sustains and directs behavior toward a goal.

title: 人格
sub: 相对稳定、跨情境的思维、情绪与行为模式的总和。
subEn: The relatively stable, cross-situational patterns of thinking, feeling and behaving.

title: 依恋
sub: 婴儿与主要照料者之间形成的持久情感联结，影响一生的人际关系。
subEn: The enduring emotional bond between infant and primary caregiver that shapes relationships for life.

title: 归因
sub: 我们如何解释自己与他人的行为原因——是性格使然，还是情境所迫。
subEn: How we explain the causes of behavior — disposition or situation.

title: 自我
sub: 个体对「我是谁」的认知与感受，包括自我概念、自尊与自我监控。
subEn: One's sense of 'who I am' — self-concept, self-esteem and self-monitoring.

title: 条件反射
sub: 巴甫洛夫的狗听到铃声就流口水，就是「条件」被「反射」出来的典型。
subEn: Pavlov's dog salivating at a bell is the classic case of a conditioned reflex.

title: 图式
sub: 你脑子里有一张「餐厅该怎么点餐」的默认模板，这就是图式；去到陌生餐厅就靠它快速应对。
subEn: You carry a default 'how to order at a restaurant' template in your head — that's a schema guiding new situations.

title: 心理防御机制
sub: 把不敢面对的欲望包装成「我根本不在乎」，就是一种防御——保护自己不被痛苦击垮。
subEn: Reframing an unbearable desire as 'I don't care anyway' is a defense that shields you from pain.

title: 认知失调
sub: 明知道吸烟有害却还在抽，心里别扭——为了不别扭，你可能暗暗说服自己「危害被夸大了」。
subEn: Knowing smoking harms yet still smoking feels off — to ease it you may quietly tell yourself 'the risk is exaggerated'.

title: 启动效应
sub: 先看到「医生」这个词，再填「__生」时你更可能写「医生」而非「学生」——隐性的联想被点亮了。
subEn: After seeing 'doctor', you're more likely to complete '__or' as 'doctor' — a hidden association lit up.

title: 强化
sub: 孩子收拾好玩具就给贴纸（正强化），或写完作业就不必洗碗（负强化），都是在「加料」让好行为更常出现。
subEn: A sticker for tidying (positive) or skipping dishes after homework (negative) both 'add incentive' for good behavior.

title: 习得性无助
sub: 笼中狗被反复电击却逃不掉，后来门开着也不敢逃——它「学会」了无助。人长期受挫也可能如此。
subEn: A caged dog shocked with no escape later won't flee even with the door open — it 'learned' helplessness. Humans under chronic failure do too.

title: 心理理论
sub: 你知道「妈妈看不见盒子里的糖，所以她不知道糖在哪」——这种「别人想法和我不同」的洞察就是心理理论。
subEn: Realizing 'mom can't see the candy, so she doesn't know where it is' — that insight that others' minds differ is theory of mind.

title: 西格蒙德·弗洛伊德
sub: 提出潜意识与心理结构（本我/自我/超我），开创谈话疗法，深刻影响了对「非理性自我」的理解。
subEn: Proposed the unconscious and the id/ego/superego structure, founded the talking cure, and reshaped how we see the irrational self.

title: 让·皮亚杰
sub: 用「图式—同化—顺应」解释儿童如何主动建构对世界的理解，提出认知发展的四个阶段。
subEn: Explained how children actively build understanding via schema-assimilation-accommodation, proposing four stages of cognitive development.

title: 伯尔赫斯·斯金纳
sub: 用操作性条件反射与强化程式解释行为，主张「环境塑造行为」，对程序教学与行为矫正影响深远。
subEn: Explained behavior via operant conditioning and reinforcement schedules, arguing 'environment shapes behavior', influencing programmed instruction and behavior modification.

title: 阿尔伯特·班杜拉
sub: 提出观察学习与自我效能，证明人不仅被强化塑造，也通过「看别人怎么做」和「相信自己能行」来改变。
subEn: Proposed observational learning and self-efficacy, showing people are shaped not only by reinforcement but by watching others and believing in their own capability.

title: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
sub: 用「系统1/系统2」解释人类如何在直觉与理性间切换，揭示了一系列稳定的判断偏差。
subEn: Explained how humans switch between intuition and reason via System 1 / System 2, revealing a family of stable judgment biases.

title: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛
sub: 用「需求层次金字塔」说明人先求生存安全，再追求归属、尊重与自我实现。
subEn: Used the 'hierarchy of needs' pyramid to show people seek safety first, then belonging, esteem and self-actualization.

title: 伊万·巴甫洛夫
sub: 用狗的唾液分泌实验发现经典条件反射，证明「联想」可以重塑生理反应。
subEn: With dogs' salivation, discovered classical conditioning — that association can reshape physiological response.

title: 保罗·艾克曼
sub: 通过跨文化研究论证基本情绪及其面部表情具有普遍性，并开发了微表情判别工具。
subEn: Argued basic emotions and their facial expressions are universal across cultures, and built tools to read micro-expressions.

title: 精神分析
sub: 以潜意识、童年冲突与驱力为核心，用谈话疗法探查行为背后的深层动力。
subEn: Centers on the unconscious, childhood conflict and drives, using the talking cure to probe deep motives.

title: 行为主义
sub: 只研究可观察的刺激—反应，用学习律解释一切行为，拒斥内在心理实体。
subEn: Studies only observable stimulus-response, explaining all behavior by learning laws, rejecting inner mental entities.

title: 认知心理学
sub: 把心智当作信息加工系统，研究注意、记忆、语言与问题解决的内部机制。
subEn: Treats the mind as an information-processing system, studying attention, memory, language and problem solving.

title: 人本心理学
sub: 强调人的主动性、潜能与尊严，关注成长、自我实现与治疗中的真诚关系。
subEn: Stresses human agency, potential and dignity, focusing on growth, self-actualization and the genuine therapeutic bond.

title: 进化心理学
sub: 用自然选择解释心智机制的起源，认为许多倾向是祖先环境中适应问题的产物。
subEn: Explains the origin of mental mechanisms via natural selection, seeing many tendencies as products of ancestral adaptive problems.

title: 神经心理学
sub: 用脑科学与神经影像把心智过程定位到具体的脑区与环路。
subEn: Locates mental processes in specific brain regions and circuits via neuroscience and neuroimaging.

title: 积极心理学
sub: 不只研究病态，也系统研究幸福、优势、韧性与意义等「如何让人生更好」的议题。
subEn: Not only pathology, but systematically studies happiness, strengths, resilience and meaning — 'what makes life worth living'.
